content.comment_body: I have set up a [product_name] device with the associated mobile app and I'm wondering if it's possible for the app to send a notification to my phone when an input or output is activated?
Currently, this type of notification function is not available.
Are you familiar with the user manual? The app version from 04/2016 doesn't offer automatic notifications; you'll need to implement a solution yourself.
Thank you [user_name], that feedback deserves a better rating. Regards.

Hi, the only solution I know of is to use the [product_name] communication module in addition, linked with the [product_name] device. Then you can specify which signal should trigger an SMS to your mobile phone. Visit [url] for more details. If this solution interests you, check if the module is available in your region, as it’s not offered everywhere. Hope this helps.
I'm not trying to be negative, but that advice wasn't helpful. I've already read the manual and couldn't find any information on whether notifications can be sent.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for a notification feature within the [product_name] mobile app to alert their phones when specific inputs or outputs are activated. The main challenge is that the app lacks direct notification capability, requiring users to find alternative solutions or use extra hardware. Community advice confirms this limitation and points to indirect ways to achieve notifications, which do not align with users’ expectations for straightforward, in-app functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the app to have a built-in feature to send notifications directly to their phones when an input or output on the [product_name] hardware is activated.
